title: the body of POST /v1/fleet/pair/ssh: SSH once, a password or a key for this call only (never stored), or a key file on the controller's machine; none: the controller host's ssh agent and keys; the route /discovery/target read (jump hosts, key file); tunnel for a rented or remote node; answers the node (node.schema.json)

key.description: a private key in OpenSSH or PEM format

key_file.description: a private key file on the controller's machine (the ssh line's -i, ~/.ssh/config's IdentityFile); ssh reads it there

jumps.description: the jump hosts in order (-J), each logged in to with the user's own keys or agent

tunnel.description: a rented or remote node: its agent stays on its loopback, reached through an SSH tunnel the controller keeps open

host_key.description: the fingerprint the user confirmed (POST /v1/fleet/pair/ssh/hostkey); a different key is refused

takeover.description: move a node another TandemApp owns to this one
